description: Knowledge graph of the bee-epic-apiary monorepo. Nodes are packages, modules, key types, HTTP routes, Durable Objects, external systems, and cross-cutting flows. Edges capture dependency, data flow, auth gating, storage, and route wiring. Intended for coding-assistant navigation and impact analysis. Companion to docs/index.json (the flat file/symbol map). v1.1 added an `analysis` block (strengths, gaps, vulnerabilities, tech-debt, scalability) from a full development-perspective review on 2026-07-25. v1.2 (2026-07-31) records a code-review remediation pass: SSE fanout race, webhook idempotency reservation, origin allow-list hardening, atomic product update, focus-trap a11y hook, client/server schema parity, and a shared typecheck/test CI gate.

nodes.label: @bee-epic/shared
nodes.summary: Canonical Zod schemas + TS types for everything crossing a network boundary. Wired as an npm file: dep; must be built before consumers.

nodes.label: services (Cloudflare Worker)
nodes.summary: Backend Worker: Stripe checkout/CRUD, auth, settings, contact email, SSE notifications, rate limiting. Manual router, no framework.

nodes.label: admin (React SPA)
nodes.summary: React 19 + Redux Toolkit admin panel. Cookie-authed. Manages products, orders, users, site settings.

nodes.label: web (React PWA storefront)
nodes.summary: Public PWA storefront. Catalog, cart (localStorage), Stripe checkout, SEO/JSON-LD.

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.summary: Source of truth for products, prices, checkout sessions, orders. API version 2026-05-27.dahlia.

nodes.label: Formspark
nodes.summary: Email delivery fallback when site content has formsparkFormId set.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Email Service
nodes.summary: env.EMAIL.send() — default transactional email path when Formspark not configured.

nodes.label: CONTENT_KV (KV)
nodes.summary: KV namespace: users, invites, resets, refresh families, auth policy, site/process/testimonials/categories content, product-count cache, webhook idempotency keys.

nodes.label: NotificationHub
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed SSE fanout, single instance ('default'). Replay window 1-24h (site-configurable), max 500 events, two-axis eviction. heartbeat()/broadcast() iterate a snapshot of the connection set and delete-in-place on failed write, so a concurrent subscribe is never dropped by a set swap.

nodes.label: RateLimiterDO
nodes.summary: Atomic per-IP rate limiting (default 100 req/min). Pure checkRateLimit() logic testable outside runtime; client fails open.

nodes.label: shared/product
nodes.summary: IProduct/IProductInput/IProductUpdateRequest schemas, EProductCategory.

nodes.label: shared/order
nodes.summary: IOrder, shipping, fulfillment status, line items, update payloads.

nodes.label: shared/settings
nodes.summary: ISiteContent, ICategory, IProcessStep, ITestimonial, INavLink, ISocialLinks, ESettingsType.

nodes.label: shared/staff
nodes.summary: EStaffRole, STAFF_ROLE_RANK, roleSatisfies(). Role rank OWNER>MANAGER>EMPLOYEE>VENDOR.

nodes.label: shared/auth
nodes.summary: IUser, IInvite, IPasswordReset, IRefreshFamily, IAuthPolicy, EUserStatus, TTL constants, toUserPublic().

nodes.label: shared/notifications
nodes.summary: INotificationEvent discriminated union + ENotificationType.

nodes.label: shared/email
nodes.summary: EmailFormat, IEmailBodyType, IOrderTemplateData, ICommTemplateData.

nodes.label: shared/api
nodes.summary: IApiResponse<T> envelope, IApiError discriminated union, ApiResponseSchema().

nodes.label: shared/stripe
nodes.summary: Stripe API response shapes (price/product/list).

nodes.label: withAuthHandler
nodes.summary: CORS -> method check -> origin allow-list -> resolveCaller -> write-method floor -> rate limit -> handler -> try/catch.

nodes.label: withStripeHandler
nodes.summary: Injects memoised Stripe client, maps Stripe errors, delegates auth to withAuthHandler. Public when no requiredRole.

nodes.label: resolveCaller auth chain
nodes.summary: cookie bea_at JWT (HS256) -> Authorization: Bearer API_SECRET_KEY (=>OWNER ci@service) -> X-Dev-Email header (dev only).

nodes.label: Checkout flow
nodes.summary: web cart -> POST /checkout -> Stripe session(s) -> redirect -> Stripe webhook -> confirmOrder -> notification + email.

nodes.label: Admin notifications (SSE)
nodes.summary: worker events -> NotificationHub DO -> GET /notifications/stream (SSE, Last-Event-ID replay) -> admin NotificationsPanel.

nodes.label: Site content flow
nodes.summary: admin Settings tabs PUT /settings/:type -> CONTENT_KV -> web fetches GET /settings/* at mount.

nodes.label: Admin cookie auth
nodes.summary: LoginPage -> POST /auth/login -> bea_at/bea_rt cookies -> whoami probe -> 401 refresh interceptor coalesced via refreshInFlight mutex.

nodes.label: admin authSlice
nodes.summary: caller/bootstrapAvailable state; fetchCaller/login/logout/refresh/changePassword thunks.

nodes.label: admin productsSlice
nodes.summary: Product list, cursor pagination, filters, CRUD thunks; AbortSignal-threaded.

nodes.label: admin ordersSlice
nodes.summary: Order list, cursor pagination, filters, detail + line items thunks.

nodes.label: web cartSlice
nodes.summary: Cart items; persisted to localStorage 'beeEpicCart' via persistenceMiddleware; Zod-validated on load.

nodes.label: web uiSlice
nodes.summary: Cart drawer open state, active section, loading.

nodes.label: GET /whoami
nodes.summary: Returns { caller, bootstrapAvailable }. Drives admin UI bootstrap state.

Role rank OWNER>MANAGER>EMPLOYEE>VENDOR (source: services/src/*/handlers). Verified per-handler: products/prices create/update/delete/cleanup = MANAGER; product-stats, orders get/update, notifications-stream = EMPLOYEE; /users/* list/invite/update/delete/reinvite = OWNER; settings/:type PUT = MANAGER; auth-policy GET = VENDOR (any authenticated), PUT = OWNER; login/logout/change-password/refresh/request-reset/complete-reset/accept-invite/bootstrap-owner = public (authenticate internally); /users/me = write-floor EMPLOYEE.
resolveCaller trust order: cookie -> bearer -> dev header (dev header honored only when ENVIRONMENT=development).
Stripe API version 2026-05-27.dahlia pinned in withStripeHandler.ts.
NotificationHub is a single DO instance named 'default'; RateLimiterDO is per-IP.
web cart persisted to localStorage 'beeEpicCart'; admin theme to localStorage 'theme'.
Email routes through Formspark when formsparkFormId is set, else Cloudflare Email Service.

analysis.verificationNote: Sync-verification pass against the codebase: all 4 package nodes, 28 API route nodes (incl. POST /products/cleanup), and 9 key invariants (envelope shape, role rank, resolveCaller trust order, Stripe 2026-05-27.dahlia pin, NotificationHub single 'default' DO, cart/theme localStorage keys, email routing) confirmed accurate. No structural drift; nodes/edges unchanged. Companion docs/index.json corrected: added services/src/utils/getClientIp.ts and refreshed ProductDetailPage.tsx + shared/src/api.ts line numbers.
analysis.method: Parallel development-perspective review of all four packages (read actual source, not docs) + a dedicated cross-cutting security sweep. Findings verified against code; build/typecheck state verified by running tsc. A follow-up high-recall code-review pass on 2026-07-31 (commit 10fffc4) remediated 11 findings and re-verified 2 as non-bugs — see `remediation2026_07_31`.
analysis.overallAssessment: Mature, well-engineered single-tenant e-commerce backend + two React frontends. Security posture is a genuine strength (defense-in-depth auth, verified webhook signatures, PII minimization). Backend test discipline is high (~1:1 spec:source, 90% thresholds). Following the 2026-07-31 remediation, the earlier P0/P1 liabilities (broken tree, no typecheck gate) are closed and several correctness/a11y edges hardened. The remaining liabilities are the under-tested storefront and the single-DO / full-catalogue-walk scaling ceilings.

strengths.summary: PBKDF2-SHA256 @600k iters, random salt, constant-time compare, dummy-hash timing defense on login. HS256 JWT with constant-time sig check + explicit exp/type/issuer guards. Role authority derived from LIVE KV user record (stale-token-proof), DISABLED users rejected even with valid JWT.

HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax + env-gated Secure (fail-closed when ENVIRONMENT unset); refresh cookie Path-scoped to /auth/refresh; full refresh-token-family rotation with replay detection that burns the family on JTI mismatch.

Stripe signature verified (constructEventAsync) before any side effect; idempotency key RESERVED in KV before dispatch (closes the concurrent-duplicate window) and released on confirmOrder failure so retries still work.

Two-layer wrapper (withAuthHandler -> withStripeHandler) with deliberate, documented ordering: CORS -> method -> origin -> resolveCaller -> write-method floor (>=EMPLOYEE for any mutating verb) -> rate-limit-last -> handler. Write-floor is a safety net even if a route forgets requiredRole.
Runtime-coupled logic extracted to pure, unit-testable functions: checkRateLimit, aggregateProductStats, paginateArray, matchesSearch/Category/Tag.

SSE replay pump detached via waitUntil to avoid TransformStream single-chunk-buffer deadlock; per-write 5s timeout so a half-open client can't stall the webhook; lex-sortable fixed-width event IDs so SQLite string ORDER BY matches numeric order; two-axis eviction (age + count<=500). Fanout iterates a snapshot of the connection set and deletes dead writers in place, so a concurrent subscribe is never lost.
strengths.evidence: services/src/notifications/notification-hub.ts (waitUntil pump, tryWrite timeout, snapshot iteration in heartbeat/broadcast)

strengths.summary: Production-grade axios client: envelope unwrap (204-aware), typed ApiError carrying IApiError, 401-refresh interceptor that COALESCES concurrent refreshes via store-subscribe, Symbol retry-marker prevents infinite loops, /auth/* excluded from refresh path.

Zod validation at every trust boundary: Stripe->IProduct transform (.loose()), localStorage cart load (drops corrupt shape, clears key), order/product updates in strict mode (reject unknown fields), DO notify() re-validates before SQLite write. Client OrderUpdateSchema now mirrors the server's order_status enum refinement, and default_price is validated with an anchored /^price_[A-Za-z0-9]+$/ regex (rejects bare prefix + newline-injection bypass).

Consistent a11y per AGENTS.md: pervasive data-testid, ARIA (role dialog/status/alert, aria-modal/labelledby/live), aria-hidden decorative icons, sr-only guard text. No dangerouslySetInnerHTML anywhere. Storefront cart dialog uses a reusable useFocusTrap hook (Tab-trap + Escape-close + focus restoration); the Navbar cart count is announced via a polite sr-only aria-live region and the numeric badge is aria-hidden.

request-reset always 200; login collapses missing/invalid/disabled into indistinguishable responses; CORS refuses credentialed wildcard; IPs truncated to /24 (v4) / /64 (v6) before storage (GDPR-conscious).

gaps.summary: No `typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) script anywhere; ~24 standing tsc errors in services were invisible because Cloudflare esbuild strips types. RESOLVED: added `typecheck` to services/admin/web + root aggregate, wired into deploy.yml test job; all errors fixed.
gaps.recommendation: Done — keep the gate; consider extending services tsconfig to also typecheck test/.

gaps.summary: SettingsType = keyof typeof ESettingsType yielded UPPERCASE ('SITE'|...) but the handler switches on lowercase KV keys ('site'|...). RESOLVED: replaced the mis-cast with a local `SettingsKey = 'site'|'process'|'testimonials'|'categories'` union that matches the router regex + actual KV keys.
gaps.recommendation: Done. Longer-term, reconcile @bee-epic/shared ESettingsType casing with the runtime KV keys so a shared type can be authoritative.

gaps.summary: Storefront (the revenue path) has near-zero component coverage and NO coverage thresholds. Cart drawer, product grid, contact form, SEO all untested. smoke.test.ts is a placeholder.
gaps.recommendation: Test CartDrawer, ProductCard/Grid, ContactPage honeypot; add thresholds block.

gaps.summary: Neither SPA has a React error boundary; a single render throw white-screens the whole app with no recovery.
gaps.evidence: grep confirmed none in admin/src, web/src
gaps.recommendation: Wrap App shells in an ErrorBoundary with a recoverable fallback.

gaps.summary: Checkout validation allows price_data-only line items, but the handler unconditionally calls prices.retrieve(item.price) to split recurring vs one-time — a price_data-only item throws on retrieve(undefined).
gaps.recommendation: Reject price_data explicitly, or branch before the retrieve split.

gaps.summary: web api unwrap throws plain Error('API error: CODE'), discarding the structured IApiError that admin preserves — no field-level validation rendering.
gaps.recommendation: Port admin's typed ApiError to web (or lift it into shared).

vulnerabilities.summary: Stripe errors with statusCode<500 relay err.message verbatim to clients (incl. unauthenticated POST /checkout), disclosing upstream identifiers/param names. Not a secret leak (Stripe scrubs keys) but more detail than needed.
vulnerabilities.exploitability: low-moderate; craft inputs that trip specific Stripe validation errors
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Map <500 Stripe errors to an app-defined safe-message allowlist; log raw message server-side only.

vulnerabilities.summary: SeoHead stringifies admin-editable KV content into <script type=application/ld+json>. Cleared as NON-exploitable today (client-only SPA, helmet DOM .innerHTML path does not execute injected <script>), but becomes real stored-XSS if SSR/prerender is ever added. Admin-authored, low likelihood.
vulnerabilities.exploitability: none today; latent under future SSR
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Escape < as \u003c in the stringified payload; add a code comment flagging the SSR risk.

vulnerabilities.summary: /whoami is handled inline in the router (NOT via withAuthHandler) so it has no rate-limit and no origin gate; the null-caller branch runs a full KV LIST (listUsers) to compute bootstrapAvailable on every anonymous GET.
vulnerabilities.exploitability: trivial to hit; bounded (KV LIST cost, boolean out)
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Cache an owner-exists flag / short-circuit the LIST, or route /whoami through the rate-limited middleware.

vulnerabilities.summary: When the RateLimiterDO is unreachable, check() returns allowed:true. Deliberate availability trade-off, but during a DO outage all brute-force/credential-stuffing throttles vanish (PBKDF2 600k is the only remaining backstop).
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Consider fail-closed (or a degraded in-isolate counter) specifically for /auth/login and /auth/request-reset.

vulnerabilities.summary: GET /products/count is public (no requiredRole), disclosing raw catalogue size (a mild BI signal). /products/stats IS correctly EMPLOYEE-gated.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Gate to EMPLOYEE if the storefront doesn't need the raw count; otherwise accept as intended.

vulnerabilities.summary: Admin mutations use withCredentials cookie auth with NO client-side CSRF token/header. Safety rests entirely on server SameSite=Lax (blocks cross-site POST/PUT/DELETE). Likely OK but no defense-in-depth; confirm server cookie flags + consider a worker origin check on mutations.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Confirm SameSite server-side; add an Origin/Referer check on mutating routes as defense-in-depth.

techDebt.summary: Two git-tracked source files were DELETED from the working tree (git status D): services/src/contact/contact-handler.ts and services/src/stripe/order/confirm-order.ts, while still imported (router.ts:30, webhook-handler.ts:3), breaking tsc/vitest/deploy. RESOLVED: restored from HEAD (commit a169161); confirmed accidental (pure deletions, importers untouched, files recently maintained).
techDebt.evidence: commit a169161; both files present + typecheck clean
techDebt.recommendation: Done. The typecheck CI gate (gap:no-typecheck-gate) now catches this class of breakage.

techDebt.summary: transformStripeProduct/transformStripeProductsList are near-identical copies in admin and web and have ALREADY diverged (unpriced-product handling: admin keeps, web drops). Belongs in @bee-epic/shared.
techDebt.recommendation: Lift the transform into shared; parameterize the unpriced-product policy.

techDebt.summary: contact-handler.ts (and settings-handler.ts) hand-roll OPTIONS/method/origin/rate-limit instead of using withAuthHandler({public:true}); the rate-limit block is a copy of withAuthHandler.ts:96-108 — divergence risk.
techDebt.recommendation: Fold both onto the shared wrapper.

techDebt.summary: Each Stripe handler re-derives :id/:email with its own regex although the router already matched it; get-products.ts uses an UNANCHORED regex vs the router's anchored one (subtly different matching contract).
techDebt.recommendation: Have the router pass the captured param to the handler.

techDebt.summary: AGENTS.md quotes admin coverage thresholds 88/85/45/88; actual enforced values are 80/67/75/78 (the 88/85/45 are stale never-met targets in a config comment). Doc drift.
techDebt.recommendation: Update AGENTS.md to the real thresholds.

techDebt.summary: SiteContentTab takes 11 callback props; SettingsPage is ~589 lines orchestrating it; web drills siteContent through every route.
techDebt.recommendation: Consider context or a settings slice for site content.

techDebt.summary: ~13 console.* calls remain in production web source.
techDebt.recommendation: Route through a logger with a prod no-op, or strip via build.

techDebt.summary: deploy.yml triggered on push to [main, release] but the repo default branch is master (and main/release aren't pushed to origin), so commits reviewed on master never deployed. RESOLVED: trigger changed to [master].

scalability.summary: Both NotificationHub and RateLimiterDO use a single 'default' instance. A DO is single-threaded + location-pinned; ALL rate-limit traffic serializing through one object is a throughput ceiling and a latency tax for distant regions. Fine for single-tenant admin; it is the hard scaling limit.
scalability.recommendation: Shard the RateLimiterDO key across N instances (hash of IP); keep NotificationHub single (fanout needs one log).

scalability.summary: fetchAllActiveProducts pages 100-at-a-time with no cap on every filtered /products, /products/count, /products/stats, cleanup; /orders walks up to MAX_SESSIONS=1000 sessions in memory. In-memory paginateArray re-fetches+re-filters the whole set per page (O(n) per page). Stripe-rate-limit-prone and CPU-heavy as volume grows; 120s KV caches only cover the UNFILTERED count/stats paths.
scalability.recommendation: Use real Stripe cursor pagination / server-side search for filtered paths before catalogue/order volume grows.

remediation2026_07_31.method: High-recall code-review pass (3 correctness + 3 cleanup + 1 altitude finder angles, 1-vote recall-biased verify). 11 findings fixed, 2 re-verified as non-bugs. Full green: monorepo typecheck clean; 953 services + 545 admin + 65 shared + 22 web tests pass; lint clean.

fixed.summary: heartbeat()/broadcast() previously could drop a connection added by a concurrent fetch() when a set was swapped; now iterate a snapshot and delete dead writers in place.
Idempotency key is now reserved BEFORE dispatch and released on failure, closing the concurrent-duplicate window that the old record-after-success pattern left open.
hostnameAllowed compared only hostname, admitting http:// downgrades and arbitrary ports; now compares full URL origin. Regression tests added.
updateProduct made two PUTs (price then metadata), risking an orphaned price if the second failed; now creates the Price first then applies metadata + default_price in a single PUT.
ProductFormDialog kept the submit button disabled after an error (submitError in the disabled expr) and never cleared the error on edit; removed the lock and clear error on input change.
New reusable useFocusTrap hook (Tab-trap, Escape-close, focus restoration) wired into CartDrawer.
Navbar cart count now announced via a polite sr-only aria-live region; numeric badge aria-hidden.
ProductCard + CartItem images got explicit width/height + loading=lazy to curb layout shift and defer offscreen loads.
Added shared:typecheck + shared:test scripts; root typecheck runs shared first; deploy.yml test job runs shared:test.
Client OrderUpdateSchema.metadata now carries the same order_status enum refinement as the server schema.
default_price regex anchored to /^price_[A-Za-z0-9]+$/, rejecting a bare prefix and an embedded-newline bypass.

reverifiedNotBugs.summary: OrdersPage cumulative URL `limit` is intentional (restores accumulated rows on reload); the 'N of M' count reads live store totalCount/orders.length, not the URL. No change.

Dashboard/ProductsPage pickFilterParams correctly strips limit and keeps only search/category; the empty unfiltered set is correct and ProductsPage re-fetches with its own filters on mount before any CUD op. No change.
